question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Off the Beaten Track
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Off the Beaten Track"** means something that is not known or popular with many people, often referring to a location or activity. (अज्ञात या प्रसिद्ध नहीं)

 
 
• **Example:** We decided to go **off the beaten track** and discovered a beautiful, secluded beach.
 
 
 
• **"Little-known"** refers to something that is not widely known or recognized. (अल्पज्ञात)
 
 
• **Example:** The** little-known** village is a hidden gem in the mountains.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Contagious** (संक्रामक): Able to be passed easily from one person to another.

 
 
• **Example:** The flu is highly contagious and can spread quickly in crowded places.
 
 
 
• **On a Strict budget** (कठोर बजट पर): To have very limited financial resources.
 
 
• **Example:** They are on a strict budget, so they have to be careful with their spending.
 
 
 
• **Adventurous** (साहसी): Willing to take risks or try out new methods, ideas, or experiences.
 
 
• **Example:** She is very adventurous and loves to try new extreme sports.
